mainEntity.name: How long does it take to create an AI email follow-up sequence that actually works?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The first version often takes longer than expected because the work includes strategy, data cleanup, prompt design, platform setup, testing, and revisions—not just writing email copy. A simple draft may be quick, while a reliable connected workflow requires more preparation.

Context: Run My AI Biz’s resources distinguish prompts from actual execution: integrations, permissions, supporting services, source verification, and approval are also required. The recommended approach is to start focused and expand after use.

Key factors:
- Number of branches and connected tools.
- Quality of customer and offer information.
- Amount of approval and testing required.
- Whether the sequence supports a launch, funnel, newsletter, or recurring operation.

Practical guidance: Separate the project into brief, draft, review, setup, test, and launch stages. Do not promise a launch date until links, merge fields, stop rules, and fallback handling have been tested.

Run My AI Biz can help owners plan the work as a repeatable business process rather than a single AI prompt.
acceptedAnswer.description: A draft may be produced quickly, but a reliable sequence also requires strategy, data cleanup, prompt design, platform setup, testing, and revisions. Separate those stages and test links, merge fields, replies, opt-outs, and stop rules before launch. Complexity and integrations determine the real timeline.
